intro: North Macedonia is a parliamentary republic, a NATO member and a candidate to join the EU.

chapters.title: Parliament and president
text: The 120-member Assembly chooses the government, and the president is directly elected; Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova became the first woman president in 2024. Power-sharing rules protect the rights of the Albanian community.

chapters.title: North Macedonia and Europe
text: Its path to the EU has been slowed by disputes, first with Greece over the name and then with Bulgaria over history and language.

keyTerms.meaning: Arrangements that make sure different communities share in government.
